description: Implement the ECS game engine core, Phaser 3 integration with the Next.js app, procedural world generation with chunk streaming, player entity with movement controls, and Supabase auth + realtime multiplayer sync. This is the core gameplay MVP.
steps: Implement the ECS framework in packages/game-engine/src/ecs/: World.ts (entity registry, system loop, component storage), Entity.ts (unique ID, component map), Component.ts (base component interface), System.ts (base system with update method and entity queries). Use a simple bitmasked archetype approach for efficient queries.

Create core components in packages/game-engine/src/components/: PositionComponent.ts (x, y, chunk), VelocityComponent.ts (vx, vy), SpriteComponent.ts (textureKey, frame, visible), PlayerComponent.ts (playerId, username, isLocal), ChunkComponent.ts (chunkX, chunkY, tiles[][]), InputComponent.ts (keys pressed state), NetworkComponent.ts (lastSync, dirty flag).

Create core systems in packages/game-engine/src/systems/: MovementSystem.ts (apply velocity to position, handle collision with tile data), InputSystem.ts (capture keyboard/touch input, translate to velocity for local player), ChunkSystem.ts (load/unload chunks based on player position, generate chunks procedurally), RenderSystem.ts (interface for renderer to consume entity state), NetworkSyncSystem.ts (mark dirty entities, prepare sync payloads).

Implement procedural world generation in packages/game-engine/src/world/: ChunkGenerator.ts (deterministic chunk generation using seed + simplex noise - generate terrain tiles: grass, water, sand, forest, stone, flowers), WorldManager.ts (manages loaded chunks, handles chunk streaming based on player viewport, loads 3x3 grid around player), Tilemap.ts (tile type definitions, tile properties like walkable/collidable).

Install Phaser 3 in apps/web (phaser package). Create apps/web/src/game/PhaserGame.ts - the Phaser game configuration and initialization. Create apps/web/src/game/scenes/BootScene.ts (load assets), GameScene.ts (main game scene that creates tilemap from chunk data, renders player sprites, handles camera follow). Create apps/web/src/game/scenes/UIScene.ts (HUD overlay scene for player info).

Create apps/web/src/components/GameCanvas.tsx - a React component that mounts/unmounts the Phaser game instance, handles resize, communicates with React state via events. Create apps/web/src/components/GameUI.tsx - React overlay UI for chat, inventory button, player info using Zustand store.

Create apps/web/src/stores/gameStore.ts (Zustand store for game state: player position, loaded chunks, online players, connection status). Create apps/web/src/stores/authStore.ts (Zustand store for auth state: user, session, loading).

Implement Supabase auth in packages/database/src/auth.ts: signUp, signIn, signOut, onAuthStateChange functions. Create apps/web/src/components/AuthProvider.tsx that wraps the app and manages auth state. Create apps/web/app/auth/page.tsx with login/signup forms using the UI package components.

Implement Supabase realtime multiplayer in packages/database/src/realtime.ts: joinRoom(roomId), broadcastPosition(position), onPlayerJoined/Left/Moved callbacks, leaveRoom(). Use Supabase Realtime Presence for tracking online players and Broadcast for position updates.

Create the database schema in packages/database/supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql: tables for profiles (id, username, avatar, created_at), player_state (player_id, x, y, chunk, last_online, inventory jsonb), worlds (id, name, seed, created_at). Include RLS policies that restrict players to their own data.

Wire everything together in apps/web/app/game/page.tsx: check auth (redirect to /auth if not logged in), initialize game engine, start Phaser, connect to realtime channel, render GameCanvas + GameUI. Ensure the player can move around the procedurally generated world, see chunks load/unload, and other connected players appear in real-time.

Add basic placeholder pixel art assets: create a simple tileset (16x16 tiles for grass, water, sand, tree, stone, flower) and a player sprite sheet (4-direction walking animation) as embedded base64 data or simple colored rectangles generated programmatically in the BootScene.

Add unit tests: packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/ecs.test.ts (test World, Entity, Component CRUD, System queries), packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/chunk-generator.test.ts (test deterministic generation - same seed produces same chunks), packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/movement.test.ts (test MovementSystem applies velocity correctly).
Update apps/web/app/page.tsx landing page to have a proper hero section with game title 'WorldNest Online', tagline, and 'Play Now' button that routes to /auth or /game depending on auth state.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds with all new game engine code compiling
pnpm test runs ECS, chunk generation, and movement unit tests and they all pass
The game page renders a Phaser canvas showing procedurally generated terrain tiles
Arrow keys or WASD move the player character around the world
Chunks load and unload as the player moves (visible in console or by terrain appearing)
Auth pages exist at /auth with login/signup forms connected to Supabase client
Realtime module exports joinRoom/broadcastPosition functions that use Supabase Realtime
Database migration SQL file exists with profiles, player_state, and worlds tables plus RLS policies
The landing page shows the game title and a Play Now button
verification: Run 'pnpm build' and confirm all packages compile without errors
Run 'pnpm test' and confirm all unit tests pass
Run 'pnpm --filter @worldnest/web dev' and verify the app starts and game page loads without console errors
